text:
Predicates:
MountainRange(x) ::: x is a mountain range.
In(x, y) ::: x is in y.
Visited(x, y) ::: x visited y.
Donated(x) ::: x was donated.
Mine(x) ::: x is a mine.
Premises:
MountainRange(picuris) ∧ (In(picuris, newMexico) ∨ In(picuris, texas)) ::: The Picuris Mountains are a mountain range in New Mexico or Texas.
Visited(juan, picuris) ::: Juan de Onate visited the Picuris Mountains.
Mine(hardingPegmatite) ∧ In(hardingPegmatite, picuris) ∧ Donated(hardingPegmatite) ::: The Harding Pegmatite Mine, located in the Picuris Mountains, was donated.
¬∃x (MountainRange(x) ∧ In(x, texas) ∧ Donated(x)) ::: There are no mountain ranges in Texas that have mines which have been donated.
Conclusion:
¬In(hardingPegmatite, newMexico) ::: The Harding Pegmatite Mine is not located in a mountain range in New Mexico.
